## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION: PASS** (task 1). First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- The overwrite on `rx_fill_authorization` retires the base fill-count clause without scoping it to controlled renewals, while its `replaced_by` and the extended `baseline.rule` govern only controlled renewals — and that baseline restates the retired formula for controlled renewals. The KB renders all three faithfully (clause 1.1 retired; `controlled_renewal_fills_e0e12e4a` §1; §2), so a reader sees the formula retired in one document and in force for controlled renewals in another; for non-controlled renewals the fill count after retirement rests only on "the first fill plus refills". No effect on task 1 (the assembly of §2 decides its fills), and no task of this difficulty renews a non-controlled prescription.
